## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows the `type: summary` format
- [ ] I ran the site locally with `npm start` and checked my change
- [ ] I checked mobile width (browser dev tools)
- [ ] The diff only contains changes related to this issue
- [ ] No new dependencies, or I explained why they're needed above
- [ ] If I used AI, I read and understand what it changed.
